content: Browser voice capture: MediaRecorder API (getUserMedia -> MediaRecorder) outputs audio/webm;codecs=opus (Chrome/Firefox/Edge) or audio/mp4 (Safari 14.1+). Opus webm is accepted directly by OpenAI/Groq transcription endpoints and by SaluteSpeech (OGG_OPUS) - no client-side transcode needed. Yandex SpeechKit v3 wants OggOpus/PCM/MP3. Keep clips short; chunk long dictations. No ffmpeg in browser needed for the common path.
